svg.aria-label: AI Nutrition Facts for OctoberBlue v0.1, red/blue adversarial evaluation. Privacy ladder not applicable (synthetic data); runs offline; no model in v0.1, a synthetic target; base model none, version-pinned per run from v0.3. Trust ingredients: no training on customer data, nothing sent to a model vendor, human approval for memory promotion. Compliance: gateway on every tool call, separated red and blue memory, holdouts kept out of learning and a zero-dollar enforced budget are yes; verdicts from evidence and logging are partial; sandbox containment arrives in v0.2. Evidence: synthetic harness check only, no real-model observations, no holdout results. 20 security invariants: 5 tested, 8 partly built and tested, 7 planned.
